paragraphs: Teacher Kim's Story, posted by Lily. Each Explorer writes about one person for our club project. I chose Teacher Kim, because she runs our club. She told me her story on Thursday in the school library. She laughed and said, "I have a long story." Here it is in short.

Kim was born in a quiet town in the north. Riding was her favorite thing as a girl. She rode a blue bike to school every day. Her bike had a small basket for her books. The school was five kilometers from her house. She rode in the rain, and she rode in the sun. She loved the quiet roads and the green fields. Still, she wanted to see the big world.

At eighteen, Kim packed a small bag and took a bus to a big city. The city was loud and very big. She lived in a small room with a friend. She found her first job at a small business. She was a secretary, and she answered letters and phone calls. At night, she studied English and wrote small stories. The boss read one story and said, "This is very good."

At twenty-two, a newspaper asked Kim to write for them. She became a journalist, and she liked the work. She wrote about schools, parks, and families. She met many interesting people. Later, she visited a school for a story. The children asked her many questions, and she loved them. That day, she decided to become a teacher.

Some people said, "It is impossible to start a new career at twenty-eight." However, Kim did not stop. She studied at night for two years. At thirty, she became a teacher at a school near a park. She has been our teacher for three years. She started the Explorers club this year. She teaches us every subject, and she is always kind. We are happy to have her. She read this page first and smiled. "Please write that I still ride a bike," she said. Which person do you want to write about? Tell us in a message!
